title: Discipline when motivation is gone

scenes.say: Motivation will leave you by Wednesday.
scenes.visual: an alarm clock glowing in a dark bedroom before sunrise

scenes.say: Discipline is what shows up when it is gone.
scenes.visual: a man tying running shoes on the edge of a bed in the dark, one lamp on

scenes.say: Nobody claps for the early mornings.
scenes.visual: an empty street at dawn with fog and a single street light

scenes.say: Nobody sees the work you do alone.
scenes.visual: a man shadow boxing in an empty gym, dust in a shaft of light
close up of a hand gripping a barbell, chalk in the air

scenes.say: That is the part that changes your life.
scenes.visual: a man standing on a rooftop watching the sun rise over the city, seen from behind

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: wide shot of a sunrise over a quiet neighborhood, warm light on the houses

caption: Motivation leaves. Discipline stays. Do it anyway.
